scope_preservation.only_additions: Passive reset audit declaration/monitor/tasks block and reset_audit_finish() immediately before the original numeric trace fclose.
scope_preservation.existing_acceptance_matrix: 22 F normal results, 10 E link-error results, 8 D discards, 32 real H retirements

resolved_before_delivery: The audit_finish call is checked to exist before the original numeric fclose; audit success is not deferred to a final block.
FIFO transition checking contains no delay, so it cannot miss a second transition during a 10 ps wait. Multiple transitions on one fast edge fail immediately.

POST derived-state checks and recovery recognition are skipped only when an asynchronous request transition occurs in that PRE-to-POST window; PRE busy/IO checks remain active and the request has its own trigger+10ps check.
static_findings.independent_review_result: Final SHA reviewed; no deterministic new sampling/count problem found; removing all audit additions recovers the original TB exactly.

audit_output.format: Whitespace-separated tagged records; ignore lines beginning with #; all timestamps are integer picoseconds printed with %0d.
audit_output.bit_encoding: bits32 is exactly 32 binary four-state characters, MSB first. Preserve 0/1/x/z (case-insensitive); do not parse the entire word as an integer when unknowns are present.

records.meaning: Clock sample. domain F=fast, S=slow. phase P is input #1step sampled before edge, sample_ps=edge_ps-1. phase A is raw POST snapshot at edge_ps+10. common_change_window=1 if reset inputs differ PRE/POST or a common_reset transition was recorded in the inclusive edge..POST interval.
Common reset assertion and asynchronous stop-stream check, check_ps=trigger_ps+10. Epoch 0 explicitly represents initial reset, trigger_ps=0; epochs 1..8 are existing cancellations.

Immediate FIFO reset transition; no delay or settled multi-signal snapshot in this record. value is 0/1, edge_ps must equal the most recent fast rising edge. Initial high value is represented by the initial A, not counted as a runtime T assertion.
First unambiguous fast POST observation of both busy outputs low for this epoch; verifies empty, completion handshake and zero stale credit/IO.
One successful audit footer written before audit fclose and before numeric trace fclose.
First audit error, flushed immediately before fatal. Any X means failure.

sampling_and_order: Each domain uses an independent clocking block with input #1step; its monitor waits on that clocking event, not another Active-region posedge callback.
A separate delay-free fast-posedge monitor records the edge timestamp used by T alignment checks.
Fast and slow processes can run at the same timestamp. Parse Q by (domain,edge_ps,phase), never by cross-domain file-line order.

PRE epoch is sampled by the clocking block; POST epoch is the variable value at POST execution. At common_change_window=1 the POST epoch can be the old or new value if the request process shares that ps. Anchor epoch transitions using A.trigger_ps and allow that exact boundary, not arbitrary mismatches.

A common transition within the 10 ps window may leave a POST snapshot inside asynchronous propagation. Keep the evidence and the independent A check; do not apply stable POST derived-state expectations to changed=1 records.
The initial A is recorded at 10 ps after declared initial reset. Subsequent FIFO reset transitions are checked without blocking delays.
audit_output.log_volume: Q is emitted only while either domain busy is nonzero/unknown, a common transition overlaps the sample window, or the corresponding domain has a remaining 16-cycle tail. Each domain manages its own tail. Assertions continue throughout the whole test even when normal-operation Q output is suppressed.

independent_python_contract.epochs: Exactly 0..8; one A and one C per epoch. Epoch 0 has no T assertion and one T deassertion; every later epoch has one T assertion then one T deassertion before C.
independent_python_contract.pairing: Exactly one P and one A Q record per captured (domain,edge_ps), P sample=edge-1, A sample=edge+10. Z.q_rows=2*(Z.fast_samples+Z.slow_samples), and domain Q-pair counts equal the footer sample counts.
independent_python_contract.time_rules: T.edge_ps=T.fast_edge_ps and matches a fast rising edge at 1000+2000*n ps. No duplicate T timestamps. A.check_ps=A.trigger_ps+10. C must correspond to its fast Q POST timestamp/snapshot. Do not require file rows from different processes at the same time to have a fixed order.
independent_python_contract.A_required_bits: 31=1; 15=0,14=0,12=0,11=0 (common reset, write/read enables, source ready and output valid). Initial A additionally proves FIFO reset bit26=1.
independent_python_contract.fast_PRE_rule: If any of bits31,28,26,25,24,23 is not known 0, bits15 and12 must be known 0.
independent_python_contract.slow_PRE_rule: If any of bits31,27,26,25,24,22 is not known 0, bits14,5,11 must be known 0.
fast_POST_rules_for_unchanged_window: If bit19=1 then bit20=1 and bits26,25=0.
slow_POST_rules_for_unchanged_window: If bit17=1 then bit18=1 and bit24=0.
If bit22=0 then bits31,27,26,25,24=0 and bits18,17=1.
independent_python_contract.C_required_bits: bits23,22=0; bit21=1; bits20..16=11111; bits8..6=000; bits15,14,11=0. There is only one C per epoch, and a later A cannot precede prior recovery.
independent_python_contract.unknown_policy: Preserve unknown bits in early reset snapshots. Required control values are four-state exact comparisons; an X/Z in a bit required to be 0 or 1 is a failure. Do not require inactive payload/diagnostic flags to be fully known at initialization.

boundaries: Native compilation and simulation have not been run. In particular XSim acceptance of these clocking-block constructs remains a required native check.
The count requirements describe unchanged test stimuli, not measured successful coverage.
S-4/S-6/S-7 vendor assertion policy and explicit private cfo_xpm binding remain root-owned work. No vendor modifications were made here.
The audit validates sampled functional reset/handshake behavior, not physical reset minimum pulse width, metastability MTBF, implementation timing or board CDC.
A delta-cycle transition that never materializes as a signal event cannot be measured by an event monitor; runtime observable FIFO-reset events are checked without a delay blind window.
Only initial reset plus the existing eight cancellations are stimulated. No extra reset waveform or additional case was introduced.
